title: Add email verification flow and fix mail configuration for SMTP fallback
scope: Email verification flow and failover mail configuration (laravel/).
notes: This artifact intentionally contains no environment variables, credentials, connection strings, or initialization secrets.

changes.summary: Redirects unverified users to the verification.notice route (409 for JSON clients).
Wires sendEmailVerificationNotification() to the branded CustomVerifyEmail notification.
notice/verify/send endpoints; notice renders the verification view for web clients.
Verification notice page with a resend form.
Default mailer set to failover with an SMTP->log fallback chain.
Verification routes plus a protected /dashboard route guarded by auth+verified.
Covers verification flow, protected-route redirect, and failover mailer fallback.
